summary: Frontend E2E testing of Zyphix homepage features: Location Picker, Live Search, Cart from Search, Cart navigation, and full Checkout flow. All 5 primary features work correctly end-to-end. Only issue found is a React hydration warning caused by nested <a> tags on the Cart page.

ui_bugs.issue: React hydration error in console: '<a> cannot contain a nested <a>'. A product link (href=/now/product/c1-1) contains a nested <a> inside another <a> (likely Link inside Link from wouter). Does not block functionality but is a real React DOM validation error printed on every load of /now/cart and /now (also fires on /now navbar). Should be fixed by using a single anchor or wrapping non-anchor markup.

action_items: Fix nested <a> tags in Cart.tsx (and possibly Home.tsx navbar) causing React hydration errors visible in browser console.

Consider clearing cart in CartContext after a successful order in Checkout.tsx (navbar cart badge remained non-zero on order confirmation page in one of the test runs — could not fully confirm; verify saveOrder side effect resets cart).
critical_code_review_comments: Nested <a> tags will cause hydration mismatch in SSR-like scenarios and are invalid HTML.
Form inputs on Checkout page lack data-testid attributes; adding e.g. data-testid='checkout-fullname' would make automated testing much more reliable.
Search dropdown section headers use ALL CAPS via CSS (uppercase); OK visually but test expectations should be case-insensitive.
test_credentials: N/A - guest flow, no auth required
seed_data_creation: None. All data is mockData.ts + localStorage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features tested via preview URL. Verified: (1) Location picker – search 'Koramangala', click chip, updates navbar; persists to localStorage key zyphix_loc (value 'Koramangala, Bengaluru') across reloads. (2) Live Search dropdown [data-testid=global-search-results] appears for 'biryani' with GROCERIES · ZYPHIX NOW + DISHES · ZYPHIX EATS + RESTAURANTS sections; 'tomato' shows groceries with Add buttons [data-testid^=search-add-]; 'zzzzz' shows 'No matches for zzzzz' empty state; Escape closes; clear button [data-testid=global-search-clear] works. (3) Clicking search-add- button increments [data-testid=navbar-cart-count] badge; multiple clicks increment. (4) [data-testid=navbar-cart-button] navigates to /now/cart. (5) Proceed to Checkout → /now/checkout → form (Full Name, Phone, Address, City, Pincode, Delivery notes) → COD is default → Place Order → navigates to /now/order/{ORDER_ID} confirmation page showing order id, delivery ETA, address, order details, and COD payment. Also verified /now shopping page has 176 Add buttons that update the cart. Only console warning: nested <a> hydration error on /now/cart.
rca of the issue: Nested <a> in Cart.tsx: The product row wraps a wouter <Link> (which renders <a>) and inside it another element also renders an <a>. Fix by making the inner element a <div>/<span>, or removing one of the Link wrappers.
